title: WE WILL NOT REST UNTIL YOU DO

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "We will not return to our homes until each of the Israelites has received their inheritance. We will not receive any inheritance with them on the other side of the Jordan, because our inheritance has come to us on the east side of the Jordan." - Num 32:18-19 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The commitment goes deeper still: "We will not return to our homes until each of the Israelites has received their inheritance." They bound their own rest to the wellbeing of every other tribe. They would not settle into comfort while a single brother remained without a home. That is the heart of true community — my rest is tied to your flourishing.

How different this is from the individualism that says, "I've got mine; the rest is your problem." These tribes tied their satisfaction to the satisfaction of all. They could not be fully at ease until everyone was cared for. This is the kind of love God calls His people to — a love that refuses to be content while others are still in need.

The early church lived this way, sharing with one another so that no one among them was in need (Acts 4:34-35). It is a picture of the family of God at its best: bound together, each one's welfare mattering to all.

Ultimately this points us to Jesus, who would not remain in the comfort of heaven while we were lost and homeless in sin. He came, He fought our battle, He secured our inheritance — and only then did He return to His rest at the Father's right hand. He would not settle until His people were brought home (John 14:2-3). Because of His self-giving love, we have an inheritance that can never perish. May we love one another with something of that same selfless heart.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Is your sense of "rest" tied to others' wellbeing, or only your own?
2. How can you refuse to be content while someone near you is still struggling?
3. How does Christ's refusal to rest until you were saved move your heart today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord Jesus, thank You that You would not rest until You had secured my inheritance. Give me a heart that cares for others' wellbeing as my own, and that loves as You have loved me. Amen.
